# A server's catalogue at the prompt
# @weight 3

With a server connected, `.tables`, `.schema` and Tab show the server's
tables, not the engine's (`lib/sql/base.x`, `lib/sql/repl.x`).  There is no
server here: `canned-link` is the harness's link whose server is the bytes
a case spells in hex, a `/` between one read and the next, and which shows
what is sent to it.  `sql-session!` is what `.connect` does once it has a
link.  The bytes were worked out apart from this bundle, by a Python
script with `struct`.

This is x-sql's own: DuckDB's shell has no server to ask.

## postgres

### connecting answers the database at the host

```x
(%seq (write (sql-session! "postgres" (canned-link "") (list "u" () "db.example" 5432 "db" "postgres" "disable"))) (newline))
```
---
```output
sent 000000310003000075736572007500646174616261736500646200636c69656e745f656e636f64696e6700555446380000
"db@db.example"
```

### .tables asks the server for the tables a bare name reaches

```x
(sql-eval-line ".tables")
```
---
```output
sent 510000007b53454c454354207461626c655f6e616d652046524f4d20696e666f726d6174696f6e5f736368656d612e7461626c6573205748455245207461626c655f736368656d61203d20414e59202863757272656e745f736368656d61732866616c73652929204f52444552204259207461626c655f6e616d6500
orders
people
```

### Tab offers the server's tables, kept from .tables, and asks once for its columns

```x
(%seq (write (sql-complete (new SqlLine text "SELECT tot"))) (newline)
      (write (sql-complete (new SqlLine text "SELECT * FROM peo"))) (newline)
      (sql-eval-line ".tables"))
```
---
```output
sent 510000008753454c4543542044495354494e435420636f6c756d6e5f6e616d652046524f4d20696e666f726d6174696f6e5f736368656d612e636f6c756d6e73205748455245207461626c655f736368656d61203d20414e59202863757272656e745f736368656d61732866616c73652929204f5244455220425920636f6c756d6e5f6e616d6500
("tot" "total")
("peo" "people")
orders
people
```

### a statement sent to the server may change them, so the next .tables asks again

```x
(%seq (display (sql-run "SELECT 1 AS n")) (sql-eval-line ".tables"))
```
---
```output
sent 510000001253454c4543542031204153206e00
┌──────┐
│  n   │
│ text │
├──────┤
│ 1    │
└──────┘
sent 510000007b53454c454354207461626c655f6e616d652046524f4d20696e666f726d6174696f6e5f736368656d612e7461626c6573205748455245207461626c655f736368656d61203d20414e59202863757272656e745f736368656d61732866616c73652929204f52444552204259207461626c655f6e616d6500
orders
people
```

### .schema of a table is its columns, in the server's own words for their types

```x
(sql-eval-line ".schema people")
```
---
```output
sent 
CREATE TABLE people(id integer, name character varying);
```

### a name the server has no table for is refused

```x
(sql-eval-line ".schema nope")
```
---
```output
sent 
Catalog Error: Table with name nope does not exist!
```

## mysql

### connecting to another server ends the session with the first

```x
(%seq (write (sql-session! "mysql" (canned-link "") (list "me" "secret" "shop.example" 3306 "shop" "mysql" "disable"))) (newline))
```
---
```output
sent 5800000004
sent 530000010da20b00000000012d00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000006d650014b32bb3a583e1340c0a1108d58b1be49781ad8c2f73686f70006d7973716c5f6e61746976655f70617373776f726400
"shop@shop.example"
```

### .tables asks for the tables of the database in use

```x
(sql-eval-line ".tables")
```
---
```output
sent 650000000353454c454354207461626c655f6e616d652046524f4d20696e666f726d6174696f6e5f736368656d612e7461626c6573205748455245207461626c655f736368656d61203d2044415441424153452829204f52444552204259207461626c655f6e616d65
customers
orders
```

### Tab offers the columns of the database in use

```x
(write (sql-complete (new SqlLine text "SELECT em")))
```
---
```output
sent 710000000353454c4543542044495354494e435420636f6c756d6e5f6e616d652046524f4d20696e666f726d6174696f6e5f736368656d612e636f6c756d6e73205748455245207461626c655f736368656d61203d2044415441424153452829204f5244455220425920636f6c756d6e5f6e616d65
("em" "email")
```

### .schema shows a column's type as the server writes it

```x
(sql-eval-line ".schema customers")
```
---
```output
sent 
CREATE TABLE customers(id int(11), email varchar(80));
```

## no server

### disconnected, the server is told and .tables is the engine's again

```x
(%seq (sql-disconnect!) (sql-eval-line "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS zebra; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ant; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS prices; CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE local_only (a INT);") (sql-eval-line ".tables") (sql-eval-line "DROP TABLE local_only;"))
```
---
```output
sent 0100000001
local_only
```
